summary_md: **ModelScope ([@ModelScope2022](https://x.com/ModelScope2022/status/2115805861108908251))** announces **Vela 3.0**, six open routing and extraction models from 0.3B to 27B that make decisions and extract entities, evidence, PII or unsupported claims in one call; vela3-fast (0.4B) tops the public Decision Index among sub-500M models ([ModelScope collection](https://modelscope.ai/collections/vllm-sr/Vela-30)).
